title: Presales Executive
description:
**Real Estate Pre\-Sales Executive** to act as the first point of contact for prospective property buyers. You will manage, nurture, and qualify incoming leads via calls, emails, and digital channels to drive site visits.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
